snippet.title: Age of Pirates RPG
snippet.description:
Sail the six seas as you lead your ship and crew to riches, fame, or the gallows in this Android RPG.
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.tresebrothers.games.ageofpiratesrpg

In this epic high seas RPG for Android you are a captain of a ship in the age of sail.  Trade, fight, and scheme to be a pirate warlord, a mercant king, or a officer in a nation's navy.
